# Library

> A catalog of 680 works in 15 collections in this repository. Each record has a permanent accession number, a link to its plate, its source file, and its technique and atom terms.

## Data

- [Catalog](catalog.json): records, technique and atom terms with the records that use them, see-also links, audit.
- [Accession register](accessions.json): record id to accession number.
- [Fixity](fixity.json): sha256 of each source file at build time.

## Collections

- [Encyclopedia](../encyclopedia/): 176 records. Techniques, atoms, explorations and couplings in one manifest. Source: `encyclopedia/manifest.js + content/<id>/entry.js`.
- [Techniques & Templates](../techniques-templates/): 209 records. Measured studies and templates. Each study has a spec. Source: `techniques-templates/_shared/entries.js + techniques/<id>/spec.json`.
- [Technique Studies](../techniques-templates/index.html#techniques): 36 records. Read plates, one reference each. Moved into Techniques & Templates on 2026-11-12; the old technique-studies/ addresses redirect. Source: `techniques-templates/studies/st-NN-*/index.html (window.STUDY inside each plate)`.
- [Printed Matter](../printed-matter-studies/): 15 records. Paper-and-ink studies on one page, each at its own anchor. Source: `printed-matter-studies/index.html (one page, one builder per study)`.
- [Single studies](../gallery/): 3 records. One-page studies that belong to no series. Source: `<folder>/index.html + tool.json`.
- [Instruments](../): 4 records. Working tools. Source: `<folder>/index.html + tool.json`.
- [MASSIVE](https://jalulia.github.io/massive/): 17 records. The MASSIVE hub: match statistics, explorations, reference motion, screensavers. Source: `github.com/jalulia/massive`.
- [Mad Money Tycoon](https://jalulia.github.io/RCT-MM/): 12 records. The game, its design document, sprite catalogue and exploration archive. Source: `github.com/jalulia/RCT-MM`.
- [Desktop Bo](https://jalulia.github.io/bo/): 15 records. The desktop pet: design document, playable builds, sprite tests. Source: `github.com/jalulia/bo`.
- [Mode Mode](https://jalulia.github.io/modemode/): 3 records. The field studio site and its About studies. Source: `github.com/jalulia/modemode`.
- [Reliquary](https://jalulia.github.io/holy-ops-v2/): 4 records. Holy Ops, the relic exchange terminal and the synth. Source: `github.com/jalulia/holy-ops-v2, relic-grid, reliquary-synth`.
- [Other sites](.): 39 records. One-page sites in their own repositories. Source: `github.com/jalulia/<repo>`.
- [Garden](.): 4 records. The garden system and its studies. Source: `Claude artifacts, local files`.
- [Loose studies](.): 131 records. Single pieces with no series: plates lifted from pages that are not online. Source: `Claude artifacts, local files`.
- [Held](.): 12 records. Work that is not on the deployed site: staged patches, proposals, and plates on the working machine. Source: `library/_build/holdings.json (hand-kept)`.

## Specs

- [TS-01 Moiré from two ring screens](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-01-moire-ring-screens/spec.json): Two ring gratings multiplied into a moiré, printed as blue and red around one hot core.
- [TS-02 Four-ink spot illustration](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-02-four-ink-spot-illustration/spec.json): A black keyline and three flat spot inks, slipped 1 to 2.5 u off register, with hatch and dot tints.
- [TS-03 Iridescent chrome on black](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-03-iridescent-chrome/spec.json): A bent chrome slab shaded through a spectral lookup table, with film grain and split-channel type.
- [TS-06 Riso three-plate separation](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-06-riso-plate-separation/spec.json): One isometric drawing printed as three riso plates, each off register by a few pixels.
- [TS-09 Grain gradient layers](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-09-grain-gradient-layers/spec.json): Three gradient panels with one soft mask, one ripple band and one grain across all three.
- [TS-10 Thermal blob field](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-10-thermal-blob-field/spec.json): Blurred blobs mapped through a ramp with one dark stop at the rim.
- [TS-11 Worn black box](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-11-worn-black-box/spec.json): A black board box, front and back, worn at every edge, with stickers and a barcode.
- [TS-12 Perforated stamp](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-12-perforated-stamp/spec.json): A red stamp with a bitten perforation and a rotated title filled with a dot screen.
- [TS-13 ASCII glyph-field animations](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-13-glyph-field-animation/spec.json): Monospace glyphs as particles: a helix, a wave, an orbit and a pulse, all drawn with fillText.
- [T-03 Strategy deck](../techniques-templates/templates/t-03-strategy-deck/template.json): A strategy-deck template — 29 layouts on a fixed 1600 × 900 stage, one per slide with a usage note (N), generated image slots, and a machine-readable template.json.
- [TS-14 Deep Space Chroma · birefringence](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-14-deep-space-chroma/spec.json): A stressed birefringent sheet between crossed polarizers, integrated over the visible spectrum.
- [TS-15 Banknote engraving](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-15-banknote-engraving/spec.json): A picture reprinted as one-ink intaglio: swelling lines, crosshatch, guilloche and one kept hue.
- [TS-16 Stipple bank and dot burst](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-16-stipple-cloud-bank/spec.json): One jittered dot lattice. Tone fields shade the banks and draw the burst.
- [TS-17 Warped ring cells](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-17-warped-ring-cells/spec.json): Rounded cells on a sheet pulled at four points, inked by thirteen pools, printed as single pixels.
- [TS-19 Arc bundles on a dashed globe](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-19-arc-bundle-field/spec.json): Bundles of thin arcs leave one hub as a trunk and fan apart at the far end.
- [TS-22 Capsule system](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-22-capsule-rain/spec.json): One capsule, drawn by one function, used as a field, a helix, a dial, controls and icons.
